verdict.rationale: The portal acknowledges delegated action: users can sign up for electronic notifications 'em representação' (on behalf of someone), and there is a dedicated service area for Certified Accountants acting for taxpayers. Nothing in the pack shows a published definition of what such a third party may or may not do. missing for 10: published authorization/mandate forms, documented role definitions and permission scopes for representatives and accountants, a statement of which signatures or acts stay personal and cannot be delegated, and independent corroboration.
